scope.initial: Advisory required-edit overlap evidence from delivered helper pair findings. Conservative original member body regions are explicit lower information, with unchosen declaration/name/scope edits unknown.
scope.next: Explicit local-only guard intents, then concrete parameter bundle intent with actual direct-call/argument evidence. No rewrite engine or similarity-based work groups.

resource_contract.coordinate_system: Half-open original file byte ranges. Convert function-relative native spans through checked exact function/source ownership; do not guess base from display line/column.
resource_contract.context_rule: Evidence/review contexts remain distinct. Same physical source region across contexts is a shared edit and cannot be declared independent.
resource_contract.snapshot_rule: Compare actual captured immutable bytes under the same owner/context as needed; checksums are optional accelerators, never equality or identity. No new SHA, no filesystem reread/canonicalization of deleted originals on replay.
resource_contract.uncertainty: Required witnessed regions may be conservative. Disjoint known required regions do not prove complete-plan independence when insertions/imports/callers/names or remaining findings are unknown.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u32)->u32 { (value+1)*2 } pub fn b(value:u32)->u32 { (value+3)*2 } pub fn c(value:u32)->u32 { (value+4)*2 }
cases.reason: Each helper proposal requires both existing member bodies to change. Shared endpoints give concrete conflicting edit regions, not a transitive three-member abstraction or proof that all proposals can be applied sequentially.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u32)->u32 { (value+1)*2 } pub fn b(value:u32)->u32 { (value+3)*2 } pub fn c(value:u32)->u32 { (value^1)&15 } pub fn d(value:u32)->u32 { (value^3)&15 }
cases.reason: Disjoint existing body edits are useful evidence, but unchosen helper declaration/name/scope edits prevent claiming complete independence.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u32)->u32 { (value+1)*2 } pub fn b(value:u32)->u32 { (value+3)*4 }
cases.reason: Two independent literal differences exceed the actual helper policy. Similarity alone does not authorize an edit plan.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u32,callback:fn(u32)->u32)->u32 { (callback(value)+1)*2 } pub fn b(value:u32,callback:fn(u32)->u32)->u32 { (callback(value)+3)*2 }
cases.reason: Unavailable candidate evidence is not evaluated-no-finding or proof that nothing needs editing.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u64)->u64 { (value+1)*2 } pub fn b(value:u64)->u64 { (value+3)*2 }
cases.reason: Completed native comparison does not supply the prerequisite supported helper finding.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u32)->u32 { if value>0 { let next=value+1; next+1 } else { 0 } } pub fn b(value:u32)->u32 { if value>1 { let next=value+2; next+2 } else { 1 } }
cases.reason: For explicitly selected body-only guard edits, distinct checked bodies in one file are physically disjoint. This is advisory edit coordination, not a correctness or safe-rewrite proof.

cases.source: pub fn a(value:u32)->u32 { (value+1)*2 } pub fn b(value:u32)->u32 { (value+3)*2 }
cases.reason: Distinct review/evidence contexts share the same original physical source edits. Context inequality cannot make a file region independent.
Short function names and equal bytes do not merge distinct original files or packages. Remaining intent-specific edits can still be unknown.
Regions are half-open byte ranges; touching boundaries do not overlap. This tests span arithmetic rather than producer-derived offsets.
A conservative whole-function region overlaps an inner required edit, even when the proposals have different detector names.
Equal paths/ranges against unequal original bytes do not establish a shared coordinate system. Never use a matching checksum alone to merge snapshots.

input_variants: body-relative span mistaken for file-relative span
cases.reason: Every region needs its checked original source owner and coordinate base. A displayed source location is insufficient edit authority.
Distinct member functions neither choose a helper name/module nor prove that generated declarations/import edits do not conflict. First slice must not invent insertion locations.
Known witnessed overlaps can still be shown, but a truncated finding roster is not a complete clean or independent plan set.

cases.source: fn callee(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u32 { a+b+c } pub fn caller(x:u32,y:u32,z:u32)->u32 { callee(x,y,z) }
cases.reason: A parameter-count finding does not choose which parameters to bundle/remove or how argument syntax changes. Similarity, type co-occurrence and legacy caller-hop settings do not supply the edit.

cases.source: fn callee(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u32 { a+b+c } pub fn caller(x:u32,y:u32,z:u32)->u32 { callee(x,y,z) }
prerequisites: complete bounded direct-call/function-value-use inventory for declared captured scope
resolved exact callee and ordered caller argument provenance
checked source spans for signature and caller argument list

required_edits: chosen bundle declaration when concrete insertion selected
expected.dependency: callee contract edit before updating dependent caller syntax

cases.reason: Caller-aware sequencing comes from the concrete signature/argument edits, not graph similarity. Cycles require explicit SCC/manual coordination, not an invented total order.

replay_cases.expected: same physical resource keys/regions/context witnesses/overlap relations from retained source snapshots, strict-replay, no capture/subprocess

replay_cases.change: Reorder equivalent saved report presentation/function handles without changing checked original owners/context
replay_cases.expected: overlap evidence unchanged; no persistent identity derived from report-local function:uN:fN labels

replay_cases.change: Replay original lib/test contexts over identical captured file bytes
replay_cases.expected: separate proof witnesses retained; physical overlap still shown; neither context suppressed or treated as a distinct editable copy

replay_cases.change: Change source owner/span association and recompute ordinary transport checksum
replay_cases.expected: source/association checks fail or footprint explicitly unavailable; no fabricated edit range

non_goals: no all-member abstraction from connected pair proposals
no inferred caller or insertion edits
no retirement of legacy groups/stacking from this bounded deliverable
no full plan independence from partial known regions
legacy_anchors: crates/rstyle-core/src/groups.rs required footprint intersection and soft hints
validation_gate: Execute initial positive/negative cases against actual delivered consumer findings and checked source owners.
Assert witness region/resource/context, not only group counts.
Preserve known overlaps with incomplete roster and exact unknown denominator.
Test scope/context/snapshot isolation and strict saved replay.
Keep next/later cases explicitly pending until their edit/evidence contracts exist.
